Reparametrize a point sequence onto uniform curvilinear arc length

Source: R/centerline.R
reparametrize_3D_curve.Rd

Thin wrapper around fiber::reparametrize() that takes a raw n x 3 point matrix (columns X, Y, Z), resamples it onto n_points equally spaced points in arc length, and returns the new point matrix.

Usage

reparametrize_3D_curve(points, n_points = NULL)

Arguments

points

A numeric matrix with columns X, Y, Z.

n_points

Target number of equally spaced points. Defaults to the number of rows in points.

Value

A numeric matrix with columns X, Y, Z and n_points rows.

Examples

m <- cbind(X = 0:10, Y = (0:10)^2 / 10, Z = 0)
m2 <- reparametrize_3D_curve(m, n_points = 20)
nrow(m2) # 20
#> [1] 20
